red_exit.description: Exit the bay first and approach the west edge of obj_007.

red_mount_low.description: Climb the 0.4 m west ledge of obj_007.

red_stage_boost.description: Reach the transverse support position beside the tall platform.

blue_exit.description: Exit the cleared bay and approach obj_007.

blue_mount_low.description: Climb onto obj_007 and settle at the boost approach.

blue_under_panel.description: Crouch, crawl beneath obj_017, and stand directly inside the blue goal.

red_to_stairs.description: Sidestep west to the centered stair approach.

red_stairs.description: Ascend the connected 0.15 m risers to obj_004.

red_align_beam.description: Turn east on the upper staging platform.

red_beam_cross.description: Narrow the stance, cross obj_010, and spread into the red goal.

supported_upper_transfer.description: Red provides an intermediate back support while blue climbs from obj_007 to obj_015.

dependencies.reason: Release the shared bay opening and west ground approach only after red is wholly on the low platform. Red may continue staging while blue exits.
Keep the low-platform landing and blue approach clear until red has turned at x=0.3 and reached its transverse support stance.
